annotations.title: What a Drift vault is worth, with its check

description: WHAT A DRIFT VAULT IS WORTH NOW, OR "NOT READ" WITH THE REASON. Equity from the spot positions in the vault’s own Drift user account, published ONLY where the drift-vaults program’s own share price agrees within 2%: every withdrawal request records the value the program gave its shares, and value over shares times the vault’s total shares is the program’s equity. `state` is `read` with `equityUsd`, `method` and `check` (programEquityUsd, differs, requestAt), or `not-read` with `equityUsd` null and `reason`: open perpetual positions, a borrow, an unpriced token, no withdrawal request on record, or a disagreement. Never zero for not read. `netDepositsUsd` beside it is what depositors put in, a different figure that is never added. Other venues answer `applies: false`. Free.
name: vault_equity
